crossRefs.note: Blessed be Yahweh, my rock, who teaches my hands to war, and my fingers to battle:
You have also given me the shield of your salvation. Your gentleness has made me great.
and a spirit of justice to him who sits in judgment, and strength to those who turn back the battle at the gate.
Yahweh says to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have held, to subdue nations before him, and strip kings of…
He makes wars cease to the end of the earth. He breaks the bow, and shatters the spear. He burns the chariots in the…
“Yahweh of Armies says: ‘Behold, I will break the bow of Elam, the chief of their might.
It will happen in that day that I will break the bow of Israel in the valley of Jezreel.”

parallels.note: He teaches my hands to war, so that my arms bend a bow of bronze.

translations.web: He teaches my hands to war, so that my arms bend a bow of bronze.
translations.bsb: He trains my hands for battle; my arms can bend a bow of bronze.
translations.kjv: He teacheth my hands to war, so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.
translations.asv: He teacheth my hands to war; So that mine arms do bend a bow of brass.
